apps.subtitle: Learn countries and capitals
apps.desc: An artifact Claude made for learning geography, installed as a desktop app.
apps.author: cjav_dev

apps.subtitle: Build a colony over 60 years
apps.desc: A planet you can install: people land on Titan and build a colony over 60 years, drawn in one shader with no libraries.
apps.author: maximbilan

apps.name: To-do List
apps.subtitle: A simple task list
apps.desc: A to-do app built in under two hours and shared with @ClaudeDevs.
apps.author: DavidCismas

apps.name: AI Architecture Survival Lab
apps.subtitle: 9 missions, 12 ways to break it
apps.desc: Design an AI system, then survive budget cuts, provider outages and security reviews across 9 missions and 12 failure modes.
apps.author: PeakGrizzly

apps.name: Podcast Lessons
apps.subtitle: Flashcards from 50+ shows
apps.desc: Highlights from Acquired, Invest Like the Best, Farnam Street and 50 other shows, turned into an interactive page with flashcards.
apps.author: SamSirapat

apps.name: Grow One Thing
apps.subtitle: Raise a bonsai, a chrysalis, more
apps.desc: Pick one of six living things, from a chrysalis (3 days) to a bonsai (60 days), and raise it through five stages into your collection.
apps.author: fighthub_jp

apps.name: Isekai Reincarnation Quiz
apps.subtitle: Which fantasy life awaits you
apps.desc: 30 pixel-art RPG scenes decide which of 16 fantasy lives you are reborn into.
apps.author: suke_aicopy

apps.name: Tarot Love Type
apps.subtitle: 320+ results, drawn as a card
apps.desc: 30 questions and 320+ results drawn as a tarot card, with attachment style and a compatibility check.
apps.author: suke_aicopy

apps.name: 500 Years of Science
apps.subtitle: Ranked scientific achievements
apps.desc: A ranked list of key scientific achievements of the last five centuries, up to the day before it was made.
apps.author: tamritzblog

apps.name: School Achievements
apps.subtitle: A school profile from one prompt
apps.desc: A full school profile site with activities, photos, vision and staff, made from a single prompt.
apps.author: Atallah147

apps.name: Signal Operator
apps.subtitle: Run every traffic light by hand
apps.desc: You switch every light at one intersection by hand. Change too early and cars crash, too late and they back up; by evening there are right-turning cars, buses and ambulances. The game ends when any direction has 8 cars waiting.
apps.author: fighthub_jp

apps.name: Exact Birthday Calculator
apps.subtitle: Your birthday, to the orbit
apps.desc: Works out the exact moment of your birthday as a whole number of trips around the sun, not a calendar date. Made by an MIT professor for people who live in a different time zone from where they were born, or were born on February 29.
apps.author: fredodurand

apps.name: Watch Out! Walking While Texting
apps.subtitle: A walk with your phone out
apps.desc: A short simulation about the danger of walking while looking at your phone. Free, no sign-up, works on phone or Windows; the same post links a companion game, Walk Beside Me, and the author also has Japanese versions of both.
apps.author: s_young_sb29

apps.name: Word AI Alt (Powered by Claude)
apps.subtitle: Edit .docx files with Claude
apps.desc: Open your .docx files and keep working in a real print layout with pages, headers and footers, page numbers, section breaks, columns, a table of contents, equations, comments, footnotes and tracked changes intact. Ask Claude to draft, rewrite, shorten, change tone, proofread, translate or turn text into a table; every AI edit is a tracked change you accept or reject. Dictation, read aloud and version history are built in, and it exports back to Word, PDF, Markdown, HTML or text.

apps.name: Excel AI Alt (Powered by Claude)
apps.subtitle: Excel files, Claude built in
apps.desc: Open .xlsx, .xls and .csv files with all sheets, formulas, formatting, charts and images. Ask questions in plain words and get the exact number plus the formula behind it. Build real PivotTables, data validation, conditional formatting, sparklines, grouped outlines and charts with trendlines, clean or classify thousands of rows with Claude, and save back to Excel with nothing missing.
apps.replaces: Copilot in Excel, GPT for Sheets, Formula Bot

apps.name: PowerPoint AI Alt (Powered by Claude)
apps.subtitle: Decks from a topic or your .pptx
apps.desc: Describe a talk, paste notes or drop in a .pptx, .docx or PDF, and Claude writes the slides in smart layouts and themes. Then edit like PowerPoint: shapes, pictures, tables, charts, diagrams, animations, transitions, video, slide master, sections and comments. Present with speaker notes and a pen, and export editable PowerPoint, PDF or handouts; slides you didn't touch come back exactly as they were.

apps.name: Acrobat AI Alt (Powered by Claude)
apps.subtitle: Read, sign, edit and ask PDFs
apps.desc: Open PDFs, Word, PowerPoint or text files and ask questions; every answer cites its pages and highlights the exact words. Highlight, comment, draw, fill forms and sign, reorder, rotate, merge and extract pages, then save a real PDF that opens in Acrobat and Preview. Summaries, outlines, table extraction to Excel, translation and read aloud are built in, and your files stay on your device.
apps.replaces: Adobe Acrobat (AI Assistant, Fill & Sign), ChatPDF

apps.name: Grammarly AI Alt (Powered by Claude)
apps.subtitle: Grammar, clarity and tone fixes
apps.desc: Write or paste text and get live underlines for correctness, clarity, engagement and delivery, each with an explanation and one-click Accept. Rewrite any sentence shorter, clearer, more formal or friendlier, paraphrase it in 9 modes, and set goals, voice and a house style guide. Opens and saves .docx, .md and .txt, and floats on top of other apps with Option+Shift+G.

apps.name: Xmind AI Alt (Powered by Claude)
apps.subtitle: Opens your Xmind and MindNode maps
apps.desc: Map ideas with Xmind and MindNode keyboard shortcuts in fourteen structures, including matrix, brace, tree table, timeline and fishbone, with a different structure per branch, with floating topics, zones, callouts, numbering, templates and version history. Open your .xmind, .opml, .mm and Markdown files and save back to the same file with Cmd+S. Claude can draft a whole map from a sentence or an article, expand any topic, summarize a branch or turn the map into an article.

apps.name: TextSniper AI Alt (Powered by Claude)
apps.subtitle: Copy text from any image
apps.desc: Paste a screenshot, drop photos or open a PDF, and get text you can edit, copy, read aloud or export. It keeps the layout, writes Markdown, turns tables into Excel or CSV, translates, and pulls receipts and business cards into fields. QR codes and barcodes are read on your computer.

apps.name: DeepL AI Alt (Powered by Claude)
apps.subtitle: Translate, polish and explain any text
apps.desc: Paste text and Claude translates it between your two languages, polishes it so it sounds native in a natural, casual or formal tone, or explains the key words and grammar. It reads the result aloud. Installed, it floats on top and Option+Shift+T brings it up anywhere.

apps.name: ELSA Speak AI Alt (Powered by Claude)
apps.subtitle: Practice speaking with feedback
apps.desc: Claude writes a short spoken passage at your level in one of 9 languages and reads it to you. Repeat it or answer its question out loud, and Claude scores what you said, corrects it and reads back a more natural version.

apps.name: Be Focused AI Alt (Powered by Claude)
apps.subtitle: Claude plans your day into sessions
apps.desc: Dump everything you need to do and Claude turns it into ordered tasks with the number of focus sessions each needs. The timer works through them, counts down in your menu bar and Dock, notifies you when a session ends, and starts or pauses from anywhere with Option+Shift+P.

apps.name: Dato AI Alt (Powered by Claude)
apps.subtitle: Time zones and meeting planner
apps.desc: Keep the cities you work with side by side, each with a day and night band. Ask in plain words, like "best time for a call with London and Tokyo", and Claude answers and moves the time slider there. Installed, the city you pick stays in your menu bar.

apps.name: Stickies AI Alt (Powered by Claude)
apps.subtitle: Notes that float on top
apps.desc: Four colored sticky notes in one small window. Claude can turn a messy note into a checklist, clean up the writing, summarize it, suggest next steps or translate it, with one-click undo. Installed, it floats above every window and Option+Shift+J hides it or brings it back.

apps.name: The Future of AI
apps.subtitle: A 3D deck you fly through
apps.desc: A presentation on the future of AI and the intelligence explosion where every slide is a full 3D scene, joined by camera moves and sound. Takes about eight minutes to watch; the author says an early Opus 5.6 built it.
apps.author: fluxxrider

apps.name: Zone of Protection
apps.subtitle: A 60-second hand-hygiene test
apps.desc: A 60-second hand-hygiene challenge scored like an antibiotic sensitivity plate: S, I or R.
apps.author: drasumant

apps.name: Mac Cleaner
apps.subtitle: A disk cleaner built in a chat
apps.desc: A Mac cleaning app the author always wanted, built in Claude and installed as a desktop app; the post shows it running.
apps.author: joseamijares

apps.name: Lumen5 AI Alt (Powered by Claude)
apps.subtitle: Topic in, MP4 out
apps.desc: Describe a video or paste a script and Claude writes an animated storyboard. Edit scenes on a timeline, add built-in music or your own song with cuts snapped to the beat, burn in captions, and export MP4 or WebM in 16:9, 9:16 or 1:1.

apps.name: Canva AI Alt (Powered by Claude)
apps.subtitle: Screens, pages, graphics, critiques
apps.desc: Describe an app or a business, or drop in a screenshot, and Claude designs mobile screens you can click through, landing pages in 2 to 3 styles, or posters and social graphics, all sharing one design system you can change live. Get a scored critique with one-click fixes, and export PNG, HTML/CSS, SVG or design tokens.

apps.name: ChatPRD AI Alt (Powered by Claude)
apps.subtitle: Think it through, then ship
apps.desc: Paste a plan, idea or decision and Claude asks the hard questions, each with a recommended answer you can accept in one keystroke. A live map tracks resolved, open and parked questions, plus terms, decisions and risks. Export a spec, PRD, questionnaire, tickets for Linear or Jira, or a handoff brief.

apps.name: Saltline
apps.subtitle: First-person shooter, built from scratch
apps.desc: A full first-person shooter Felix Rieseberg had Fable 5.2 build from one-shot prompts. Every model, sound and texture is generated in code, with no outside assets.
apps.author: felixrieseberg

apps.name: Weird Web Demos
apps.subtitle: HTML-in-Canvas playground
apps.desc: A set of odd, animated demos that show off HTML-in-Canvas in the Claude desktop apps, made by the engineer who switched it on. Flash-era fun in one page.
apps.author: felixrieseberg

apps.name: Nori Desktop Shark
apps.subtitle: A shark pet for your desktop
apps.desc: A small shark swims along the bottom of your screen once you install it as an app. Rub it, double-click its fin to make it leap, or right-click to toss it fish.
apps.author: felixrieseberg

apps.name: Felt
apps.subtitle: Seamless felt texture generator
apps.desc: Draws seamless felt-like background textures live with a shader. Pick the colour, pattern, tile size and resolution, then download a 1024 px tile.
apps.author: A-Marko

apps.name: Facade Synth
apps.subtitle: Build a street like a synth
apps.desc: A synthesiser for Georgian terrace streets: turn knobs and step a sequencer where each step is one house. Randomise, mutate, snapshot and save designs as patch code.
apps.author: Tomasmillar

apps.name: Daisy Tube
apps.subtitle: Make a computer sing
apps.desc: Recreates the 1961 Bell Labs voice that sang Daisy Bell. Drag the scope to shape a vowel in a 44-section vocal tube and adjust pitch, lips and breath.
apps.author: Ok_Nectarine_4445

apps.name: Gigantua
apps.subtitle: Fly around a black hole
apps.desc: An interactive black hole: hover, orbit or fall in and watch light bend around it. Toggle Doppler and redshift effects, or take the guided tour with sound.
apps.author: robotsmakelove

apps.name: Warikan Roulette
apps.subtitle: Split the bill, spin the remainder
apps.desc: A bill splitter for group dinners: mark each person as paying more, normal or less, round to 100, 500 or 1,000 yen, and let a roulette decide who covers the leftover. The result copies straight into LINE.
apps.author: fighthub_jp

apps.name: Computers and Architectural Design
apps.subtitle: A slide history of design tools
apps.desc: A growing slide deck on how computers changed architectural design in Japan and around the world, starting from the era when large buildings were drawn without them. The author plans to try it as a university lecture.
apps.author: shuta0331

apps.name: Kit Subscriber Map
apps.subtitle: Newsletter subscribers on a globe
apps.desc: Kit's founder installed an artifact that maps his newsletter subscribers around the world by count and by influence, pulling the data from his Kit account. Video in the post; no public artifact link.
apps.author: nathanbarry

apps.name: Teal AI Alt (Powered by Claude)
apps.subtitle: Resume, tracker, interview coach
apps.desc: Build an ATS-friendly resume in six templates with a live preview that exports exactly as shown to PDF and Word. Paste a job post to get a keyword match score, a tailored version you approve edit by edit, and a cover letter. Track every application on a board and rehearse with a mock interviewer that scores each answer.
apps.replaces: Teal, Rezi, Kickresume, Final Round AI

apps.name: Anki AI Alt (Powered by Claude)
apps.subtitle: Spaced repetition, quizzes, AI cards
apps.desc: Study decks with the same FSRS scheduler as modern Anki, or practise with Learn, Test and Match like Quizlet. Paste notes or drop a PDF, Word file or photo, and Claude writes cards or a practice quiz for you to review before adding. Import your Quizlet sets and Anki .apkg decks with their review history; everything stays on your computer with one-click backup.

apps.name: QuillBot AI Alt (Powered by Claude)
apps.subtitle: Sounds like you wrote it
apps.desc: Paste any text and rewrite it in 11 modes, from Standard and Natural to Shorten, Academic and your own voice, with every changed word highlighted. Click a word for synonyms or a sentence to rephrase it, and let the AI tells check find stock phrases, em dashes and "it's not X, it's Y" in English or Chinese, then fix them in one click. History, version compare and Word export are included, and your samples and history stay on your computer.

apps.name: YNAB AI Alt (Powered by Claude)
apps.subtitle: Give every dollar a job
apps.desc: A zero-based budget like YNAB: assign the money you have to categories, roll it over month to month, set targets, and see overspending the moment it happens. Import your bank's CSV, OFX, QFX or QIF, or bring your YNAB, Mint, Monarch or Copilot export; Claude sorts the transactions into categories and answers questions about your spending. No bank login and no subscription; your data stays on your computer.

apps.name: Speechify AI Alt (Powered by Claude)
apps.subtitle: Listen to anything you read
apps.desc: Turn PDFs, EPUBs, Word files and articles into audio with word-by-word highlighting, and pick up where you left off. Skip by sentence or paragraph, change voice and speed, set a sleep timer, and bookmark passages. Claude summarizes chapters, explains hard passages and cleans up messy PDF text.

apps.name: Photomath AI Alt (Powered by Claude)
apps.subtitle: Every answer double-checked
apps.desc: Snap, paste or type any math, physics or chemistry problem and get a step-by-step solution where every step explains why. Each answer is checked by substitution, an independent second solve, and a calculator, and you're warned when they disagree. Hint-only mode, practice problems and a mistake notebook with spaced review help you actually learn it.

apps.name: Miro AI Alt (Powered by Claude)
apps.subtitle: Sketch, diagram, explain with Claude
apps.desc: An infinite canvas with Excalidraw's shortcuts, a hand-drawn or clean look, shapes, connectors that stay attached, sticky notes, frames, pen, align and group. Open .excalidraw files, Mermaid and images, and export PNG, SVG, PDF, Excalidraw or Mermaid. Describe a flowchart, sequence diagram, architecture, org chart or timeline and Claude draws it as shapes you can edit, or explains the board.

apps.name: Fitbod AI Alt (Powered by Claude)
apps.subtitle: Plan, lift, eat, progress
apps.desc: Tell Claude your goal, days and equipment and get a calendar of workouts that adds weight when you earn it. Log sets fast from the keyboard with previous-set ghosts, RPE, rest timer and PRs, and track food with macro targets and photo estimates. Imports your Strong, Hevy and MyFitnessPal history.

apps.name: Wordwall AI Alt (Powered by Claude)
apps.subtitle: AI lessons, games and worksheets
apps.desc: Tell Claude the grade, subject and topic, and it writes vocabulary, quizzes, a reading passage with leveled versions, a lesson plan and a rubric. Turn the same content into a projector quiz show with team scores, matching, word search, crossword, wheel of names and more, or print worksheets with answer keys as PDF and Word.

apps.name: Leaf Blower
apps.subtitle: A game designed by kids
apps.desc: A small leaf blower game built from ideas the author's kids dictated straight into Claude. Plays in the browser, and works best installed as an app.
apps.author: felixrieseberg

apps.name: Family Recipes
apps.subtitle: Photos of recipes, neatly formatted
apps.desc: Snap a picture of a handwritten recipe card and Claude turns it into a clean, consistent recipe you can keep. Made to save a family's recipes.
apps.author: dfeinition

apps.name: Kaun Banega Gareeb?
apps.subtitle: Comedy quiz: don't go broke
apps.desc: A comedy quiz game where you start rich and answer questions trying not to lose it all. Built by borrowing Duolingo's look and turning it into something sillier.
apps.author: Rupali254

apps.name: Decision Log
apps.subtitle: Log decisions and their reasons
apps.desc: A B2B-style tool for recording decisions along with the context and reasoning behind them, so you can look back and see why a call was made. Styled after Notion.
apps.author: dasSagnik1999

apps.name: Afterimage
apps.subtitle: A playful dream journal
apps.desc: A dream journal with a light, animated feel for writing down and revisiting your dreams. The author kept refining its motion and interactions to make it nicer to use.
apps.author: designirdeep

apps.name: The Life of Oxy
apps.subtitle: An oxygen atom's random life
apps.desc: A tiny life simulator where you follow an oxygen atom through chemical reactions (O2, H2O, CuO and more); each run ends in a different fate with its own rarity and score.
apps.author: yuuhafuru_umi

apps.name: Laika's Mission
apps.subtitle: A kinder space mission, sound on
apps.desc: An interactive tribute imagining a NASA mission a century from now that explores space without sending animals, inspired by Laika. Best experienced with sound on.
apps.author: TweetsbyIsha

apps.name: Japanese Conjugation Visualizer
apps.subtitle: See Japanese verbs conjugate
apps.desc: An interactive view of how Japanese verb conjugation works: the six bases arranged on a hexagon, showing how the vowel shifts with each following form. It does the morphological analysis with AI, with a heavier offline dictionary mode as a fallback.
apps.author: habakari101

apps.name: Calculus in Motion
apps.subtitle: Watch derivative and integral
apps.desc: A 3D visualization of why differentiation and integration are inverse operations. Instead of just reading the formulas, you move the graph through space to feel the relationship, and can step through it slowly yourself.
apps.author: habakari101

apps.name: Adding Past Ten
apps.subtitle: Practice sums over ten
apps.desc: A small practice tool a parent made for a child learning to add when the sum crosses ten. Simple and focused, meant to be handed to a kid working on the same thing.
apps.author: sikakkar

apps.name: LVTI Liverpool Quiz
apps.subtitle: Which Liverpool player are you
apps.desc: A 30-question personality quiz that matches you to the Liverpool FC player you most resemble, and even tells you which player you'd clash with. A football-fan spin on the MBTI format.
apps.author: MitsuLIV

apps.name: Guess the Red
apps.subtitle: Name the Liverpool player
apps.desc: A guessing game where you work out which Liverpool player is being described. The author kept adding fixes and replay features to make it last longer.
apps.author: MitsuLIV

apps.name: Which AI Tool
apps.subtitle: Find your AI tool type
apps.desc: A 10-question, two-minute quiz that sorts you into an AI-tool type and names the assistant that fits you. Made by the author as a quick, shareable diagnostic.
apps.author: EveSte3

prompts.title: Official example prompts
prompts.note: "Make a Pomodoro timer that lives in my menu bar", "remind me to stretch every hour", "rename the photos in a folder by date".

prompts.title: 10 apps you can build this weekend
prompts.note: Menu bar pomodoro, PR review checklist, invoice maker, habit tracker with notifications, meeting cost calculator and more.

prompts.title: Add an export button first
prompts.note: Ask Claude for an "export to JSON" button before installing, so your data isn't stuck inside an app tied to your account.

prompts.title: Personal app builder prompt
prompts.note: Four phases: interview you about a weekly annoyance, pick and spec one app, build it as a self-contained artifact, then test it and list every permission it will ask for.

prompts.title: The nudge that keeps a timer honest
prompts.note: A follow-up prompt that adds an honest nudge: if a task runs past 90 minutes the timer asks whether you're still on it, with a 4:30pm daily summary and a menu bar item. Grant notifications and the menu bar, refuse full computer access.

prompts.title: Make an artifact look like a real desktop app
prompts.note: A paste-in restyle prompt to run before you Install as app: drop the centered card and fill the window, add a 48px top bar, use one accent color, a tight 4/8/12/16/24/32 spacing scale, and no gradients or emoji.

guides.title: I took apart an installed app: 404 KB
guides.note: Two tiny native binaries and an icon; the page renders inside Claude's own Electron process.

guides.title: Gridbloom teardown
guides.note: The installed app is a launcher with none of the code inside; it opens Claude Desktop, which shows the artifact in its own window under your login.

guides.title: How it compares with a web app shell (Chinese)
guides.note: @dotey on why it feels like a Chrome web app and why it still needs to be online.

guides.title: Same prompt, two results: Swift app vs installed artifact
guides.note: A menu bar Pomodoro asked for twice: the Code tab produced an 832 KB Swift app that runs without Claude but never changes; the artifact updates whenever it is edited, and the install option had not reached the account yet.

guides.title: If 'Install as app' is missing, restart Claude
guides.note: One user only saw the Install as app option after fully quitting Claude from the tray and reopening it.
